last_scene.summary: After an uneventful eight-day journey from Blumund, the party reached Eurazania's northern road checkpoint within the prepaid guard period. Arlequino theatrically introduced himself as Maestro Arlequino, cited two large concerts in Blumund and said he came to write songs worthy of Eurazania's warriors and ruler. Checkpoint chief Dagr challenged him to state his true destination. Arlequino answered that he was going to the capital and intended to meet the ruler because he could not honestly praise a ruler only from hearsay. He then took Rena's guitar, announced a song titled 'Эуразанская ночь', said he had dedicated it to the Eurazania of his dreams and, while looking at an unnamed female beastfolk guard, added that he would now dedicate future work to what he saw in reality. He began a public performance at the checkpoint. Exact lyrics are not stored because the user did not provide them in this scene.
